none: PAS LIN-956C56: Silver Roman finger ring inscribed TOT
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver finger ring, Henig Type XI. The ring is very worn and smooth, with an oval hoop in cross-section and a flat oval bezel inscribed with the letters 'TOT'. The lettering is very crude and also very worn. The 'T's have split terminals and the letter 'o' is depicted as a pointed oval. This ring is the same one as published in de la Bedoyere, 2002: 117 no. 72
